_comment: Recruiter-style questions for comparing embedding models (ml/evaluate_encoders.py). Paraphrased so they don't share wording with the CV. `answers` are passage titles; any one in the top results counts. `unanswerable` questions have no answer in the CV and should score below the similarity threshold. Written before measuring any model.
